primitiveBudget: one continuous register strip, nine generated proof fragments, four liftable material misprints, and no imported imagery
commitThreshold: drag across 68% of the proof strip with pressure at least 0.45, then release
memoryRule: the source fragment remains exact while a different slot gains offset, phase, scale, angle, and registration scar; four misprints persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch drags across the strip; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight selects; Enter/Space performs the deterministic trace; Delete lifts; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: shutter wall, pressure slab, and WEBGL suspended vessel -> Canvas 2D continuous proof strip with nine abstract fragments
compositionRupture: staggered wall, single object, and deep vessel -> horizontal register sequence with no privileged centre or aperture
encounterRupture: proximity visit, pressure return, and stillness hold -> correction drag across the strip and release
temporalRupture: remote absence, false membrane, and social echo -> wrong placement remembered as a persistent material overprint
mediumRupture: Canvas planes and WEBGL depth -> 2D proof marks, register line, phase bars, and generated misregistration
changedRule: A travelled correction does not stay at its source: release makes a real misprint in a different slot while the source remains exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a dark warm register strip with nine irregular fragments. A valid correction makes a different fragment offset, widened, re-phased, and overprinted; four misprints compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if short or weak drags commit, if the source changes, if the misprint is only colour or readout, if every release targets the same slot, if later memory resets, if lifting is inexact, or if the image reads as another Naive object grammar.
deletionCondition: Delete v047 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish copy-error memory from v044-v046 or if crossing and release do not produce visible structural change.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
